All_Condition_Data_Deltas %>%
  filter(IRI_Delta <= 150, IRI_Delta >=-20) %>%
  filter(YEAR_RECORD != 2015) %>%
  arrange(YEAR_RECORD) %>%
  mutate(Year = factor(YEAR_RECORD,
                          levels = c(2016,2017,2018,2019,2020,2021,2022,2023,2024))) %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarize(Mean_IRI_Delta = mean(IRI_Delta,na.rm = T)) %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_histogram(aes(x = Year,y = Mean_IRI_Delta),stat = "identity") +
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle("Mean DC IRI Delta By Year")
